statement: A developer system card or government AISI evaluation reports a model at the developer's highest published autonomy or AI-R&D risk tier (system cards, AISI reports; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2023. Tiered risk frameworks were first published this year; deployed models were placed at the lower tiers (ASL-2; illustrative 'medium' autonomy against a top tier of 'critical'). No government AISI evaluation reports were published in-phase.

items.summary: A top-5 developer published a tiered safety-level framework and stated that its current safety standards correspond to the second level; higher levels were defined for models with greater catastrophic or autonomy risk.
items.detail: Anthropic, 'Introducing Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy' - 'ASL-2 measures represent our current safety and security standards'. Date 2023-09-19 not shown in extracted text (approximate).

OpenAI Preparedness Framework (Beta), 2023-12-18, scorecard p.15: 'Model Autonomy Medium Low'. The scorecard appears to be illustrative rather than a formal rating of a named model - reviewer should confirm.

items.summary: The frontier model's system card reported that an external evaluator found it probably not yet capable of autonomous replication and resource acquisition.

A top-5 developer reported results of frontier-threat red-teaming (notably biosecurity) and said it was briefing government and labs; it framed risks as near-term but did not place models at a top risk tier.
items.detail: Anthropic, 'Frontier threats red teaming for AI safety' (date ~2023-07-26, not shown in extracted text; approximate).
